description: Browser Harness Daemon RPC schema — versioned contract for Python and TypeScript clients.
transport: ND-JSON over Unix socket (one command line → one response line)

error_envelope.screenshot: string | null (path to screenshot on error)

ping.description: Health check — verify the daemon is alive.

page_info.description: Get current page metadata (URL, title, viewport, scroll position, content dimensions). Returns dialog info if a JS dialog is active.

navigate.description: Navigate the current page to a URL.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot. If 'path' is provided, the PNG is written to disk and the path returned. Base64 data is never inlined in responses.

screenshot_base64.description: Capture a screenshot and return the base64-encoded PNG data.

click.description: Click at pixel coordinates (x, y) with optional button and click count.

type.description: Insert text at the focused element via Input.insertText.

press.description: Press a single key (e.g. Enter, Tab, Backspace, Escape, Arrow keys).

scroll.description: Scroll the page by dy pixels at (x, y) via a mouse wheel event.

evaluate.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page context with returnByValue and awaitPromise.

extract.description: Extract text content or an attribute from the first element matching a CSS selector.

fill_input.description: Fill an input field: focus, select all, clear, type character-by-character, then dispatch input + change events for framework compatibility.

tabs.description: List all open page tabs. Alias for list_tabs.

new_tab.description: Create a new tab, attach to it, and optionally navigate to a URL.

switch_tab.description: Activate an existing tab and attach a session to it. Enables CDP domains on the new session.

close_tab.description: Close a tab. If no target_id is provided, closes the current tab.

dialog_dismiss.description: Accept or dismiss a JavaScript dialog.

wait_for_element.description: Poll for a CSS selector in the DOM until found or timeout.

http_get.description: Perform an HTTP GET request outside the browser (via urllib). Useful for fetching raw data without navigation.

upload_file.description: Upload a file via a file input element using CDP.

drain_events.description: Drain buffered CDP events (dialog openings, network events, etc.) and return them.

run_procedure.description: Execute a deterministic step list. Interpolates {{variable}} placeholders from the optional params dict, runs each action sequentially, captures store_as values, and evaluates verify assertions with configurable failure policy.

params.steps: array — list of step dicts, each with 'action' and action-specific fields

report_outcome.description: Report a skill execution outcome to the worker's skill-health JSONL log.

params.success: boolean — whether the skill execution succeeded
params.error: string | null — optional error message on failure

health.description: Return overall health and capability info for the backend.

UNKNOWN_ACTION.message: The requested action is not recognized

CDP_DISCONNECTED.message: CDP WebSocket connection is lost or not established

NAV_TIMEOUT.message: Navigation did not complete within the timeout

ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: A required DOM element was not found

MISSING_PARAM.message: A required parameter was not provided

INVALID_JSON.message: The command line is not valid JSON

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.message: The backend does not implement this method

NO_DIALOG.message: No JavaScript dialog is currently open

TAB_NOT_FOUND.message: The requested tab target was not found

INVALID_STEPS.message: Procedure steps must be a list

TIMEOUT.message: Read timeout on the IPC socket
